pre_state_capture.configuration: exact bytes plus SHA256, or absence

atomic_writes: configuration temporary file followed by os.replace
registration temporary file followed by os.replace
commit_boundary: The install commits only after target promotion, bootstrap configuration write, and staging registration write all succeed.
rollback_sequence: mechanically verify pre-state and residual artifacts
new_config_cleanup: A configuration created by the failed operation is removed.
pre_existing_config_restore: A pre-existing configuration is restored byte-for-byte through an atomic replace.
residual_state_reporting: partial_state_cleaned is true only when every cleanup step succeeds and no tracked residual or pre-state mismatch remains.
